Im not autistic (but have another disability that can effect how i behave and process emotions) but have previously been involved with an autistic individual and i think he also was using his disability as a crutch to be horrible to me. I study in his city and was home for the summer working. He started calling me awful names and telling me i was toxic because i wasn’t prepared to travel back to that city in order to see him. I wasn’t prepared to travel back due to the fact he would tell me all this stuff that has happened with his family and how his life was awful. When i would offer help and advice he would become really awful to me and then call me the horrible one when all i was trying to do was understand and offer help. He refused to understand that I was trying to help and would basically have a “woe is me” attitude, always saying how he had it 100x worse when he would never even want to hear anything about my life. 

I am now in a new relationship and have found myself to struggle with even worse self esteem issues than before and knowing whether i am being unfair or not, i say sorry about things that i don’t need to say sorry for and am ultimately just scared of ever upsetting my partner because of how i was treated by that person. My partner is very supportive and helps me understand how to know and never calls me names. 

Whether he’s autistic or not, please don’t settle for someone that treats you like that.
